args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter (Retail returns logistics): Highlights rising apparel return rates and the shift toward consolidated return-processing hubs as a cost-saving strategy.
- Linked article: Apparel return rates have hit 24%; consolidating return handling into dedicated hubs cut processing costs by roughly 20%.
- Companion piece: Found that reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of their original margin, underscoring the value of fast turnaround in the returns pipeline.
